title: 第九章 摆架坤宁宫第一章 我不知道
lines: 作为一个狗皇帝，一个昏君，必然是有着惊世智慧，能够做出常人所不能理解的事情。
就好比眼下这道疑似发昏发狂的圣旨。
不过这就是圣天子。
圣天子寂寞如斯，也是常人所无法理解的。
虽然不知道自己为什么要这么做，但左墟总觉得在自己那个时代，赞拜不名、入朝不趋、剑履上殿的套餐下来，只要是一个臣子脸色都差不多快绿了。
既然自己不怕暴力造反，那狠狠恶心一手试图博取谥号文忠的丞相大人自然是乐意的。
不过左墟乐意。
其他人可就不乐意了。
圣天子在乾清宫笔走龙蛇的时候，左右侍立，隐约靠近的几位宫女脸色都绿了，都是欲言又止。
大宫女雪梅此刻不在圣天子身边，其他人还不敢用自己孱弱的躯体来考验左墟的脾气和生撕精铁的力量。
江河文明的人有一个共性。
那就是第一个吃螃蟹的人如果没事，其他蜂拥而至的人可以把螃蟹捞绝种了。
雪梅姑姑都可以服侍圣天子，素手接触高贵龙体，还被巨龙炮给宠爱了俏脸，凭什么她们不行？
不过左墟这荒唐圣旨一下。
倒是成功让乾清宫的宫女们都觉得自己应该再等等，她们不介意自己跟着一个暴君，但还是有些介意自己献身给一个疯子，哪怕左墟对于陈椎是有着十成乃至九成的把握，只是故意在恶心他。
将圣旨甩给了随意一位宫女，左墟便毫无人君姿态的躺下了，显然是要休息一下。
“什么圣旨？慢着。”
一道脆生生的声音忽然在殿外响起。
随后不经通传，一道竹绿色的身影就径直闯入了乾清宫，劈手就从宫女的手上夺过了圣旨。
不是，你这么勇敢吗？
我是帝皇啊！
给左墟都整精神了，刚刚躺下去又坐直了起来，定睛一看这来的又是哪里的高手了？九族的储备还充足么？
“这圣旨倒也马马虎虎，相爷得知肯定是开心的，只是还需要太后和皇后娘娘过目，加上懿旨才能服众。”
这位绿色宫装的宫女年纪不大，老气秋横指点江山状。
容颜和身段可以打个七分。
就是神色面相略显小人刻薄，一幅盛气凌人的架势，直接把这七分给扣到了五分。
‘她是谁？’左墟思索皱眉。
“圣上，这位是青竹姑姑。”身侧一位粉裙宫女小声提醒道，她的声音很有特点，似蝴蝶扑扇翅膀撩人心尖。
左墟马上就从不重要的记忆中翻出来这青姑姑是谁了，皇后娘娘身边的大宫女之一，虽不属于六局一司，但因为贴身伺候皇后，所以地位极高。
以前在左墟这个傀儡这里。
青竹姑姑嚣张跋扈的很，训斥这个喝骂那个，像是雪梅之类的宫女，都被她给威胁甚至是上刑过。
就比如现在。
粉裙宫女的咬耳朵狐媚样让青竹的眼睛一竖！
“交头接耳，冒犯圣上，成何体统？你是谁的宫女？若不说出好歹来，去宫正司领罚！”
左墟身边的宫女要么是安插的耳目，要么是六局一司定期轮换。
目的是避免这位傀儡养出心腹。
“回青竹姑姑，妾为宫正司司正花蝶。”
content_en:
As a dog emperor and a foolish king, he must have amazing wisdom and be able to do things that ordinary people cannot understand.
Just like the current imperial edict that seems to be crazy.
But this is the Holy Emperor.
It is beyond the comprehension of ordinary people that the Holy Emperor is so lonely.
Although he didn't know why he did this, Zuo Xu always felt that in his time, when the package of worshiping without fame, entering the court, and going to the palace with swords and shoes was given, a minister would almost turn green.
Since he is not afraid of violent rebellion, the prime minister who cruelly and disgustingly tries to win the posthumous title Wenzhong is naturally happy.
But Zuo Xu was happy.
Others were not happy.
When the Holy Emperor was walking around in the Qianqing Palace, the palace maids who were standing around and vaguely approaching him all turned green, and they all hesitated to speak.
The eldest palace maid Xuemei was not with the Holy Emperor at the moment, and the others did not dare to use their weak bodies to test Zuo Xu's temper and strength to tear apart iron.
The people of Jianghe Civilization have one thing in common.
That is, if the first person to eat the crab is okay, other people who flock to the crab can kill the crab.
Aunt Xuemei can serve the Holy Emperor, touch the noble dragon body with bare hands, and even have a pretty face pampered by the giant dragon cannon. Why can't they?
But Zuo Xu’s ridiculous imperial edict.
It succeeded in making the maids of Qianqing Palace feel that they should wait. They didn't mind following a tyrant, but they still minded dedicating themselves to a madman. Even though Zuo Xu was 100% or even 90% sure about Chen Zhui, they were just deliberately disgusting him.
After passing the imperial edict to a random palace maid, Zuoxu lay down in an unruly manner, obviously wanting to take a rest.
"What imperial edict? Wait."
A crisp voice suddenly sounded outside the hall.
Then without any communication, a bamboo-green figure broke into Qianqing Palace and snatched the imperial edict from the palace maid's hand.
No, are you so brave?
I am the emperor!
Zuo Xu had regained his composure. He had just laid down and sat up straight again. He took a closer look and saw who was the master here? Are the reserves of the nine tribes still sufficient?
"This imperial edict is just so-so. The Prime Minister will definitely be happy when he finds out. It just needs the Queen Mother and the Empress to see it and add the decree to convince everyone."
This palace maid in green palace clothes is not very old, and she has an old-fashioned attitude and looks like she is pointing out the country.
Appearance and figure can be rated as seven points.
It's just that his expression was slightly mean and domineering, which directly deducted the seven points to five points.
'who is she? ’ Zuo Xu thought and frowned.
"Your Majesty, this is Aunt Qingzhu." A palace maid in a pink skirt beside her reminded her in a low voice. Her voice was very distinctive, like a butterfly flapping its wings to seduce people's hearts.
Zuo Xu immediately found out from unimportant memories who this young lady was. She was one of the eldest maids beside the Queen. Although she did not belong to the Six Bureaus and One Division, she had a very high status because she served the Queen personally.
I used to be here at the puppet Zuoxu.
Aunt Qingzhu was very arrogant and domineering. She scolded this one and scolded that one. Palace maids like Xuemei were threatened and even tortured by her.
Just like now.
The pink-skirted maid's ear-biting and flirtatious manner made Qingzhu's eyes stand up!
"What kind of behavior is it to offend the Holy One by whispering to each other? Whose palace maid are you? If you don't tell the truth, go to the Palace Chief to receive your punishment!"
The palace maids around Zuo Xu are either the eyes and ears installed, or they rotate regularly in the six bureaus and one department.
The purpose is to prevent this puppet from raising henchmen.
"Back to Aunt Qingzhu, I am Gong Zhengsi Sizheng Huadie."
